title: Biochar amendment effects on grain yield and Fusarium crown rot severity in winter wheat: a greenhouse study (SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE)
reviewer_note: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE generated with the scientific-peer-review skill. All data are invented.
summary: Four biochar rates were applied to wheat in pots inoculated with Fusarium culmorum; yield and crown rot severity were measured and a farm recommendation is made.
overall_assessment: The design confounds biochar rate with greenhouse bench (C-001); the analysis treats repeated measures as independent (C-002); a P-value is misreported (C-003); the Abstract and Discussion overreach (C-004 to C-006).
strengths: Growth conditions and soil are adequately described.
Degrees of freedom for yield are consistent with the design.

recommendation.decision: Reject (encourage resubmission after a replicated experiment)
recommendation.would_change: Evidence that benches were replicated and randomised.

limitations: No supplement, raw data or code; Figure 1 image not included in the example.
